content:
Rork  we remove you several time please  stop to add you on my app IVX — FULL RORK INDEPENDENCE MIGRATION

GOAL:
Make IVX fully independent from Rork.

Rork must NOT be required for:
- source control
- GitHub synchronization
- builds
- deployments
- backend runtime
- frontend runtime
- authentication
- environment variables
- CI/CD
- mobile builds
- testing
- monitoring
- certification
- production recovery

SOURCE OF TRUTH:
The official IVX GitHub repository and independently controlled production infrastructure.

PHASE 1 — AUDIT

Search the entire codebase and deployment configuration for all Rork dependencies, including:

- rork.com
- rork-app
- RORK_
- Rork-specific Git remotes
- Rork deployment URLs
- Rork environment variables
- Rork APIs
- Rork build scripts
- Rork CI hooks
- Rork-generated runtime configuration
- Rork-specific paths
- Rork authentication or tokens
- Rork proxy/tunnel services
- Rork-hosted assets
- Rork-specific Expo configuration

Classify every result as:

A. runtime dependency
B. build dependency
C. deployment dependency
D. development-only reference
E. documentation/history only

Do not delete anything yet.

PHASE 2 — ESTABLISH INDEPENDENT CONTROL

Verify:

1. Official GitHub repository exists and is writable.
2. GitHub is the canonical source of truth.
3. Production deployment can originate directly from GitHub.
4. Production environment variables are controlled outside Rork.
5. Backend can start without Rork.
6. Frontend/mobile app can build without Rork.
7. API endpoints do not rely on Rork infrastructure.
8. Authentication does not depend on Rork.
9. Database/storage connections are independent.
10. CI/CD can execute without Rork.

PHASE 3 — REMOVE RORK DEPENDENCIES

For every confirmed Rork dependency:

- replace it with independently controlled infrastructure
- make the minimum safe code/config change
- preserve existing behavior
- remove obsolete Rork configuration only after replacement is proven

Do NOT remove historical text/comments unless necessary.

PHASE 4 — INDEPENDENT BUILD

From a clean environment:

- clone from official GitHub
- install dependencies
- build backend
- build frontend
- run automated tests
- start backend
- start frontend
- verify API connectivity

No files from a Rork workspace may be required.

PHASE 5 — INDEPENDENT DEPLOYMENT

Deploy directly from the official GitHub repository using the production hosting platform.

Prove:

LOCAL/CI SHA
=
GITHUB SHA
=
PRODUCTION SHA

Capture actual deployment evidence.

PHASE 6 — MOBILE INDEPENDENCE

Verify Android and iOS projects can be built without Rork.

Android:
- production-equivalent APK/AAB build
- install
- launch
- API/auth test

iOS:
- production archive/build
- signing configuration
- TestFlight readiness where infrastructure permits

PHASE 7 — FINAL INDEPENDENCE TEST

Temporarily assume Rork is completely unavailable.

Verify IVX can still:

- clone
- build
- test
- deploy
- start
- authenticate
- reach database
- serve APIs
- run frontend
- build mobile apps
- recover/redeploy

EVIDENCE GATE:

Do not report independence from code inspection alone.

PASS requires real execution evidence.

Do not fabricate:
- commits
- SHAs
- pushes
- deployments
- test output
- builds
- logs
- credentials
- device tests

FINAL OUTPUT:

RORK RUNTIME DEPENDENCIES:
<number>

RORK BUILD DEPENDENCIES:
<number>

RORK DEPLOYMENT DEPENDENCIES:
<number>

RORK DEVELOPMENT-ONLY REFERENCES:
<number>

OFFICIAL SOURCE OF TRUTH:
<repo>

INDEPENDENT BUILD:
PASS / FAIL / NOT VERIFIED

INDEPENDENT DEPLOY:
PASS / FAIL / NOT VERIFIED

PRODUCTION SHA VERIFIED:
YES / NO

ANDROID INDEPENDENCE:
PASS / FAIL / EXTERNAL-BLOCKED

IOS INDEPENDENCE:
PASS / FAIL / EXTERNAL-BLOCKED

RORK REQUIRED FOR PRODUCTION:
YES / NO

FINAL VERDICT:
IVX FULLY RORK-INDEPENDENT
or
IVX NOT YET FULLY RORK-INDEPENDENT
